import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "src"))

from do_again.service.daemon import _pending_outbox
from do_again.service.runtime import runtime_layout

state = runtime_layout(repo).state_dir
target_name = "receipt-batch-final-drain-1926138-4a7d1c9e3b62.json"
target = state / "browser_outbox" / target_name

before = [p.name for p in _pending_outbox(state)]
removed = False
if target.exists():
    target.unlink()
    removed = True
after = [p.name for p in _pending_outbox(state)]

uid = os.getuid()
label = "io.github.tran-steven.do-again.41857a676462"
cmd = f"sleep 2; launchctl kickstart -k gui/{uid}/{label}"
subprocess.Popen(
    ["sh", "-c", cmd],
    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    start_new_session=True,
)

print(json.dumps({
    "head": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
    "before": before,
    "removed_verified_tail": removed,
    "after": after,
    "restart_scheduled": True,
    "label": label,
}, indent=2))
